headline: From solution design
to software in production.
hero.description: I lead a cross-functional team of nine building a digital payments platform with 3 million users. My work spans solution architecture, full stack development, and platform reliability.

about: I've been building fintech products since 2022, progressing from frontend developer to full stack engineer to solutions architect.

Today I own solution design for new initiatives, stay involved in implementation, and help teams through critical production incidents. I also build tools and engineering workflows that other developers can use across the organization.

I started in mechatronic engineering and international project leadership. That experience shaped how I work: take ownership from start to finish, coordinate across disciplines, and stay composed when the stakes are high.
experienceIntro: At Devsu since March 2022, on a long-term engagement with Banco Pichincha and its fintech Deuna.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
paragraphs: Lead three frontend engineers, three backend engineers, and three QA engineers on Deuna's P2P and QR payments app. Own solution design across mobile and backend services, align architecture across teams, and define priorities with Product Owners.
Lead platform restructuring, service migrations, and production war rooms. Introduced an AI-native delivery workflow and rolled it out to the team.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
paragraphs: Joined Onboarding as a React Native developer and expanded into backend engineering as demand grew. Built the Restate workflow framework, improved teen onboarding and re-enrollment, and delivered account closure, reopening, and self-service management flows.

jobs.title: Frontend → Full Stack Developer
paragraphs: Named Banco Pichincha's Best Developer in 2022 and 2023.

Led frontend delivery for digital banking onboarding, built micro frontends and BFF services, and helped define the stack and architecture for greenfield products. Delivered the Pichincha Mundialista campaign on time and made Onboard Express's WebView integration reusable across later in-app integrations.
Between engagements, contributed to Devsu's internal talent platform, Profile, using Next.js, Firebase, and GCP.

jobs.title: Transition to Software Engineering
paragraphs: Full-time, self-directed training in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, and cloud development. Built personal projects ranging from app clones to automated web services.

jobs.title: Project Leader
jobs.company: AGP Group · promoted from Projects Trainee
paragraphs: Led specialty-glass projects across engineering, quality, sourcing, logistics, and production. Managed French and Japanese client relationships in English, negotiated schedules and requirements, and transferred process know-how from the Peru plant to Colombia.

jobs.title: Research & Development Intern
paragraphs: Designed mechanical, electronic, and software solutions for telemetry and computer vision in mining fleets.

work.title: Reliability for 3 million users
work.label: Platform reliability
paragraphs: Led the stability program that reduced the share of monthly users experiencing at least one error from 15% to under 2%. Worked with the team to identify root causes, prioritize fixes, and delegate implementation.
Alongside this, led a re-architecture involving service migrations, microservice restructuring, and new modules on a platform that had grown for years.

work.title: A workflow framework adopted organization-wide
work.label: Sagas & durable execution
paragraphs: Designed and built an internal framework over Restate implementing the Saga pattern with automatic retries, compensations, and orchestration. It became the organization's standard for asynchronous workflows.

work.title: AI-native delivery, from ticket to reviewed PR
work.label: Engineering workflow
paragraphs: Built a Claude Code workflow connecting Jira, GitHub, Confluence, and Android emulators. It covers solution design, test-driven implementation, pull requests with visual previews, and AI-assisted code review.
Created custom skills for documentation, architecture diagrams, and codebase exploration, then rolled the workflow out to the team.

work.title: Rebuilding digital account onboarding
work.label: Frontend & BFF architecture
paragraphs: For Transactional Account, led frontend delivery during a rebuild that rewrote 30 microservices and moved the web app to micro frontends. Designed and built every micro frontend and BFF service.
For Unique Accounts, led the frontend team bringing savings accounts for minors into the mobile app, cutting account creation time by 85%. Designed the micro frontend communication architecture.
As one of two core developers on Flexible Account, chose the stack, defined the architecture, and reverse-engineered undocumented legacy services.

projectsIntro: I build tools for problems I encounter in daily life, from tracking what I eat to understanding where my money goes. These projects turn those needs into software I can use.

projects.name: Grams
projects.description: I built Grams to make daily food logging less of a chore. I can scan a barcode, photograph a nutrition label, or tell the AI assistant what I ate, then compare the day's intake with my calorie and macro goals. Installable as a web app, with offline access to previously loaded data.

projects.name: Yupana
projects.description: I built Yupana to see my spending across cards in one place, without entering every purchase by hand. It turns bank email alerts into categorized transactions and compares spending with recent habits. Financial records stay in an encrypted database on my phone, with optional AI assistance for unfamiliar alerts.

projects.name: Inklab
projects.description: A tool for a practical printing problem: colors on a screen don't match ink on fabric. Generate CMYK test patches, export a print-ready PNG at 300 DPI, then use the closest printed patch to refine the next batch. Runs entirely in the browser, with local presets.
